CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.name: MetroMart Wallet Switchers
CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.behavior: HSIC SoW declined while MetroMart Wallet SoW increased noticeably. Customers prefer the wallet for quick micro-transactions and stored balance convenience.
CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.targetRationale: Largest segment representing 47.0% of all decliners (₹58.74M annual MetroMart spend). Shifting spend from Wallet to HSIC recovers high-margin card transaction volume.
CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.intervention: Gamified 3-transaction bonus (₹150 statement credit upon 3 consecutive card payments) + 1.5% auto-reload bonus when linking HSIC to MetroMart Wallet.
CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.successMetric: Reactivate 1,000+ customers (20% conversion); lift HSIC SoW by 12+ percentage points.

CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.name: Cash/UPI Switchers
CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.behavior: HSIC SoW declined while Cash or UPI payments surged (+10.93 pp cohort shift). Customers default to UPI apps for perceived zero-friction checkout.
CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.targetRationale: Second largest segment (2,721 customers, ₹30.36M annual spend). UPI adoption eroded card habituation despite HSIC providing superior cashback rewards.
CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.intervention: Contactless Tap & Pay campaign: Instant ₹50 cashback on tap payments > ₹500 at checkout + RuPay credit linkage on UPI apps for 2x reward points.
CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.successMetric: Shift 18%+ of Cash/UPI spend to HSIC; achieve 500+ reactivated active monthly cardholders.

CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.name: Competing Card Switchers
CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.behavior: HSIC SoW declined while Debit Card (+4.16 pp) or Other Bank Credit Card (+5.04 pp) share increased. Customers are actively using rival bank cards at MetroMart.
CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.targetRationale: Critical attrition signal: Customers actively choose competing bank cards despite HSIC offering market-leading 5% Grocery & 3% Electronics benefits.
CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.intervention: Targeted "Best Rate Guarantee" campaign highlighting 5% Prime Grocery / 3% Electronics advantage + 2% bonus cashback match in customer top spending category for 90 days.
CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.successMetric: Reduce rival card SoW from 23.4% to <10%; retain ₹6M+ in card volume.

CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.name: High-Value Rapid Decliners
CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.behavior: Top 25% annual spenders (threshold: ₹17,998+) whose HSIC SoW plunged by >= 20 percentage points. Spending heavily at MetroMart (avg ₹27,645/yr) but HSIC card usage dropped from 45%+ to 11.8%.
CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.targetRationale: Highest revenue impact segment: 1,701 customers generating ₹47.02M annual spend with ₹41.47M slipping to other payment methods. Retaining these VIPs provides the highest ROI.
CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.intervention: Tiered festive milestone vouchers: ₹1,000 MetroMart gift voucher on ₹25,000 spend + 5% flat uncapped rewards across all categories during festive quarter + dedicated concierge support.
CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS.successMetric: Reactivate 25%+ VIP customers (425+ accounts); recover ₹15M+ in HSIC card spend.
